module_summary: Virtual-FIFO write side: segmented input data crosses clock domains through a gray-pointer dual-clock FIFO, then a burst controller issues AXI write bursts into a ring buffer, tracking start/finish pointers via a response-length FIFO.

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-segment dual-clock input FIFO RAM buffering write data.

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Input-clock write pointer of segment FIFO.

anchors.name: write_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: System-clock read pointer of input FIFO.

anchors.name: write_fifo_wr_ptr_sync_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer synchronized via gray code into system clock domain.

anchors.name: write_fifo_occupancy_reg
anchors.why: Input FIFO occupancy; sizes bursts and triggers full-burst start.

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_full
anchors.why: Segment FIFO full; deasserts input_ready.

anchors.name: write_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Input FIFO empty; blocks FIFO read and output valid.

anchors.name: input_valid_int_reg
anchors.why: FIFO output word valid; gates burst start, timeout and data transfer.

anchors.name: input_read_en
anchors.why: Consumes FIFO output word into AXI write data.

anchors.name: input_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment input valid writing segment FIFO.

anchors.name: input_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment ready when FIFO not full and not in reset.

anchors.name: input_data
anchors.why: Segmented input data written into FIFO RAM.

anchors.name: input_watermark
anchors.why: Input FIFO above watermark or in reset.

anchors.name: input_rst_out
anchors.why: Synchronized cfg_reset in input clock domain; clears input pointers.

anchors.name: wr_burst_reg
anchors.why: Burst-active state: idle issues AW, active streams W beats.

anchors.name: wr_burst_len_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beats in current burst; sets wlast and ends burst.

anchors.name: wr_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Partial-burst timeout countdown.

anchors.name: wr_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Timeout flag allowing partial burst start.

anchors.name: fifo_full_wr_blk_adj_reg
anchors.why: Ring buffer has no space for next block; blocks burst start.

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Ring-buffer write start pointer; forms AXI address and occupancy.

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write completion pointer advanced on each B response.

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr_blk_adj_reg
anchors.why: Block-aligned start pointer for full-space check.

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr_in
anchors.why: Read-side finish pointer used for occupancy and full computation.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_burst_len
anchors.why: FIFO of outstanding burst lengths for finish-pointer update.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Response FIFO write pointer.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Response FIFO read pointer, advanced on bvalid.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_we_reg
anchors.why: Writes burst length into response FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid for each new burst.

anchors.name: m_axi_awready
anchors.why: AXI AW ready clears address valid.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Burst address: base plus masked start pointer.

anchors.name: m_axi_awlen
anchors.why: Burst length output.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data from FIFO output.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: AXI W ready advancing data transfer.

anchors.name: m_axi_wlast
anchors.why: Last beat of burst.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid advancing finish pointer.

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Enables burst generation.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: Ring buffer base address added to burst address.

anchors.name: sts_fifo_occupancy
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO occupancy output.

anchors.name: sts_write_active
anchors.why: Writes in progress or outstanding.

groups.name: Input CDC FIFO
groups.description: Segmented dual-clock FIFO with gray-coded pointer synchronization.

groups.name: Reset synchronizer
groups.description: Synchronizes cfg_reset into the input clock domain.

groups.name: Burst controller
groups.description: Decides burst start, length and timeout; streams W beats.

groups.name: Ring pointer tracking
groups.description: Write start/finish pointers of the virtual FIFO ring buffer.

groups.name: AXI write master
groups.description: Registered AXI AW and W channel outputs.

groups.name: Response length FIFO
groups.description: Queues burst lengths to advance finish pointer on B responses.

groups.name: Status
groups.description: Occupancy, empty, full and write-active status.
